notes.title: Update for August 19th - v.1.0.3.5
notes.content: [p]Bugfixes:[/p][p]-Changed an image in [spoiler]L5, so that it no longer uses the word "click" with controllers.[/spoiler][/p][p][/p][p]Puzzle tweaks:[/p][p]-Sharpened the edge in [spoiler] Blue temple, so it's more clear that the piece fits there.[/spoiler][/p][p][/p][p]Other:[/p][p]There have been some problems that a few users have had with running the game, and I have some custom builds available now to address those. To access these, you have to go to properties, then betas, and then there is a dropdown menu.[/p][p][/p][p]If the VRAM requirements are too steep, there is now a build that uses less than 400 MB of VRAM peak, which is called "vram-test".[/p][p][/p][p]If you have an AMD card which doesn't seem to run the game, I built the game with a more modern renderer that seems to help. This is the "gles3" branch. You can also use HDR monitors with this branch.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're playing on a version of Windows earlier than 10, the Steam client no longer supports those versions of Windows and the Steam API calls were failing, so I built a version without any API calls for achievements. This is "no_api".[/p][p][/p][p]I will maintain these and keep them up to date with the main branch. They should all have the latest bugfixes and changes as of 1.0.3.5.[/p]

notes.title: Update for August 12th - v. 1.0.3.3
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

-Fixed an issue in [spoiler] power cord where sometimes pieces would crash the game. [/spoiler]
-Fixed a bug in [spoiler] "The Latest in Jigsaw Technology" where two pieces could clip.[/spoiler]
-Fixed a bug in [spoiler] RYB 3 where on the final puzzle you could place pieces in the center. [/spoiler]
-Fixed a bug where sometimes the wrong save icon would appear.

Puzzle tweaks:

-Moved [spoiler] one of the clues of Hamburger Maestro slightly more to the right so you can see it better. Identifying which bun it is wasn't supposed to be part of the puzzle. [/spoiler]
-Replaced an image in [spoiler] Captchallenge, level 4, because an AI detector flagged it as being likely AI generated. Thank you to the person who brought this to my attention.[/spoiler]
-Added a word to [spoiler] Unusual Padlock, to better clarify which letter is meant on the top screen. [/spoiler]

notes.title: Update Notes for August 9th #3 - v. 1.0.3.2
notes.content:
-Fixed a different softlock in [spoiler] the long path in the tape puzzle. Interestingly enough, this had a different root cause than the other ones. [/spoiler]
-Actually fixed [spoiler]the pieces after "break the world" being stuck diagonally. At least, I think I did. [/spoiler]

-Fixed an issue where mashing a button on controller would slowly move your cursor. 
-Fixed an issue on the Steam Deck where the cursor would jump after pressing a button.

Thank you for playing!
FLEB

notes.title: Update Notes for August 9th #2 - v. 1.0.3.1
notes.content:
A few small bugfixes:
-Fixed a typo in [spoiler] Strange Jigsaws (2025) [/spoiler]
-Fixed an issue with [spoiler] pieces getting stuck rotated after breaking the world [/spoiler]
-Fixed an issue with [spoiler] possibly getting stuck returning from the jigsawverse to the void after solving the game in a particular way. [/spoiler]

notes.title: Update for August 8th
notes.content:
A few fixes for common problems:

-Improved RYB 3 answer checking code, which hopefully should resolve the issues there.
-Fixed a softlock in [spoiler] the long path in the "puzzles on tape" round [/spoiler]
-Fixed an issue in [spoiler] 20 small mazes, where you could move the exit [/spoiler]

I have a bug tracker on the bug forum where you can see the progress of any bugs, if you're curious.

Thank you for playing!

FLEB
